requirement: LaTeX/math fences retain last good partial layout only when source extends it; unsupported syntax falls back; long formulas scroll horizontally and do not steal vertical transcript scroll.
why_not_bounded: MD-009 cannot be a live-wired patch because NO real math layout engine exists anywhere in the workspace, and the live consumer discards the rendered frame. The only trait impls of MathLayoutEngine are the fail-closed sentinel NoMathEngine (crates/cli/src/native_math.rs:420, returns MathFailure::Unavailable) and the #[test]-only StubEngine (:914, inside mod tests). The live painter `paint_fence_block` builds MathRenderer::without_engine (:2321) which always yields MathOutcome::Fallback and paints the plain code block. The layout boundary MathLayout (:371-375) carries geometry only { width, height, baseline } and the live consumer's Rendered arm only debug_asserts (:2328-2330); it never paints formula cells. No latex/katex/tex crate is present in any Cargo.toml.

missing_seams.why_no_live_consumer: The trait has no production implementor; the only non-sentinel impl is test-only. The layout result models geometry only, so it cannot carry the laid-out math glyphs the requirement renders.
missing_seams.required_producer: A real LaTeX/math layout engine: TeX-style parser plus glyph layout (fractions, operators, symbols) returning painted cells. Upstream delegates to packages/latex (types.ts, markdown.ts).

missing_seams.why_no_live_consumer: The live consumer is hard-coded to without_engine; its Rendered arm only debug_asserts. It cannot paint a laid-out formula and cannot drive horizontal-scroll-without-stealing-vertical-scroll, because it never emits formula rows.
missing_seams.required_producer: A glyph-cell carrier (or cell-returning engine API) plus a live render path copying formula cells into transcript rows with a horizontal scroll box that does not consume vertical wheel/scroll.
